# audit-remediation-loop

Runs the full audit, remediation and review loop. A read-only audit with numbered, evidenced findings, a remediation plan with one executable item per finding, a completeness check against the audit, execution as one commit per item, an item-by-item conformance review, and gap-closing rounds until convergence. Includes the relay between an implementer session and a read-only reviewer session. Use when asked to audit then remediate, write a remediation plan, run a conformance review, close audit gaps, or relay a remediation prompt between sessions. Do NOT use for a one-shot code review or red-team read, for root-cause analysis of a single failure (use root-cause-analysis), or for a fix with no audit behind it.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r audit-remediation-loop ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r audit-remediation-loop .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/audit-report.md`
- `references/execution-and-review.md`
- `references/relay-protocol.md`
- `references/remediation-plan.md`
